question: Why does hub-and-spoke coordination outperform a fully-connected peer-to-peer mesh for a growing fleet of specialized agents?
summary: Derived from communication combinatorics (O(N^2) vs O(N)), single-source-of-truth consistency, failure isolation, capability-directory duplication, and LLM context economics that hub-and-spoke/orchestrator-worker should dominate; corpus (Anthropic engineering blog, 2025-2026 multi-agent orchestration writeups) confirms hub-and-spoke is the dominant production pattern for exactly these reasons.
